quality_reasons: Identity was properly verified with name, DOB and phone number before discussing the record.
Agent was empathetic and correctly escalated to the Patient Relations supervisor to open a formal grievance.
Agent made an unauthorized commitment to cover lost wages that the supervisor had to walk back on the same call.
Supervisor handled the escalation well: opened grievance G-260411, approved the prep-kit reimbursement, rescheduled the procedure and arranged a nurse call.
Excessive small talk, repeated screen timeouts and audio glitches made the call inefficient and stretched a simple complaint well beyond necessary length.

flags.description: The agent promised the caller that lost wages would be covered, a decision outside her authority that the supervisor later clarified could only be made by the review committee.
flags.evidence: we'll definitely cover your lost wages. I'll make sure of it.

flags.description: The patient received contradictory pre-procedure fasting instructions (text message vs mailed packet), leading to cancellation of her colonoscopy.
flags.evidence: the text message said I could have clear liquids up to two hours before my arrival ... no, the instructions say nothing after midnight

flags.description: The patient, a diabetic on insulin, was not asked about her insulin use before the prep and had to guess her doses, an unaddressed safety gap until she raised it herself.
flags.evidence: I'm diabetic, I'm on insulin. Nobody asked me about that last time either, and I was guessing on my insulin doses during the prep

action_items.task: Open formal grievance G-260411 regarding conflicting prep instructions and send written acknowledgment

action_items.owner: patient relations supervisor / grievance review committee
action_items.task: Review grievance with the endoscopy center and the text-reminder team and issue a written response, including the lost-wages reimbursement request
Cover/approve the cost of the second prep kit (approved on the call)
Reschedule colonoscopy for Thursday, April 30, arrival 7:30 AM, same endoscopy center
Call patient before the procedure to review prep instructions in writing and go over her insulin plan for prep day
Note 'electronic preferred' communication preference on the account

summary_notes: Patient Henrietta Moss-Okwuosa (DOB 7/17/1968, verified) called to complain that her 4/14 colonoscopy was cancelled by the anesthesiologist because her text reminder said clear liquids until 2 hours prior while the mailed packet said nothing after midnight. She lost unpaid wages, her sister lost a day, and she must repurchase the prep kit (~$30). Formal grievance G-260411 opened; written acknowledgment within 5 business days; lost-wages reimbursement referred to review committee (agent's blanket promise corrected); second prep kit cost approved. Rescheduled Thursday 4/30, 7:30 AM arrival, same endoscopy center; GI nurse to call beforehand with written prep and insulin plan (patient is diabetic on insulin). Prefers electronic communication; pharmacy on Ferris Avenue confirmed.
notable_details: Rescheduled colonoscopy: Thursday, April 30, 2026, arrival 7:30 AM, same endoscopy center.
Conflicting prep instructions: reminder text allowed clear liquids until 2 hours before arrival; mailed packet said nothing to eat or drink after midnight.
Patient is diabetic and on insulin; she was not asked about this before the cancelled procedure and guessed her doses during prep.
Second prep kit cost (~$30) approved for reimbursement; lost wages reimbursement is NOT guaranteed and goes to the review committee.
Patient prefers electronic communication over mailed documents.
Preferred pharmacy on Ferris Avenue confirmed as unchanged.
Cancellation line: patients can reply to the reminder text to cancel.
Caller was told to bring photo ID, insurance card, and an updated medication list to the rescheduled appointment.
Agent's systems repeatedly timed out (2-minute idle logout, 30-day password rotation) and her headset was glitchy, extending the call.
